bodyMarkdown:
## Converting Your Hourly Rate to Annual Pay

If you have an hourly rate or a salary offer, the standard formula to estimate your annual gross pay is:

**Annual gross pay = hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

This calculation assumes you work the same number of hours every week, with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, allowances, or salary sacrifice. For full-time roles, we assume a 38-hour week, which is the ordinary hours under the Fair Work Act. You can also work out your fortnightly pay by multiplying your weekly pay by 2.

### Using the Timesheet Tool

Our [the timesheet](/) lets you enter your base hourly rate. A checkbox adds 25% casual loading on top if you are a casual employee. Never enter a rate that already includes casual loading – the tool applies it separately. The result shows your annual, monthly, fortnightly, and weekly gross pay, plus an estimate of tax and superannuation.

## Teachers Salary Victoria: What the Data Shows

The keyword **teachers salary victoria** often brings up questions about average pay. According to the Australian Bureau of Statistics, full-time adult ordinary time earnings in Victoria were $2,041.10 per week as of May 2026. This is an average across all full-time employees in the state, not a median for the teaching profession. Actual teacher salaries depend on your classification (e.g., graduate, experienced, leading teacher), the school sector (government, Catholic, independent), and any applicable enterprise agreement.

For a quick estimate, if you multiply the Victorian average weekly earnings by 52, you get around $106,137 per year. But remember: this is an average, not a guaranteed figure for any individual teacher. To find your exact pay, refer to your award or workplace agreement.

## Minimum Wage, Award Rates, and Casual Loading

It is important to distinguish between the National Minimum Wage, award rates, and casual loading. The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. For casual employees, the minimum casual rate is $33.05 per hour (including 25% loading).

Most teachers are covered by awards such as the *Educational Services (Teachers) Award 2020* or state-specific agreements. These awards set minimum pay rates that are higher than the National Minimum Wage. For example, a graduate teacher under the Victorian Government Schools Agreement earns well above the minimum. Always check your award or agreement for the correct rate.

Superannuation is paid on top of your ordinary earnings at 12% (the super guarantee rate from 1 July 2026). This is not deducted from your pay; your employer adds it separately, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year.

## Tax and Take-Home Pay Estimates

Your annual gross pay is subject to income tax and the Medicare levy. For the 2026–27 financial year, the resident tax rates are:

- Nil on the first $18,200
- 15% on income from $18,201 to $45,000
- 30% on income from $45,001 to $135,000
- 37% on income from $135,001 to $190,000
- 45% on income above $190,000

Medicare levy is generally 2% of your taxable income, though single reduction thresholds from 2025–26 are used here (the 2026–27 thresholds were not confirmed). This estimate does not include HELP repayments, the Medicare levy surcharge, or salary packaging.

For a more detailed breakdown of your net pay, see our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) guide.

## Using Pay Guides and Reference Tables

To find the correct award rate for your job, visit [pay guides](/blog) for links to Fair Work Ombudsman resources. You can also check [reference tables](/data) for ABS earnings data and tax tables. If you are comparing job offers, our [job pay](/topics/job-pay) page explains how to evaluate total compensation including super and allowances.

Remember: the annual figure from the simple formula is an estimate. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax uses the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.

### Fortnightly and Monthly Figures

If you are paid fortnightly, simply multiply your weekly gross pay by 2. For example, if your weekly pay is $1,000, your fortnightly gross is $2,000. Monthly pay can be estimated as annual gross divided by 12. These figures help you budget and compare salary offers.

## Summary

Whether you are a teacher in Victoria or any other worker, converting your hourly rate to annual pay is straightforward using the formula hourly × hours per week × 52. Use our [the timesheet](/) to get a quick estimate including tax and super. For award-specific rates, always refer to the Fair Work Ombudsman or your enterprise agreement. The **teachers salary victoria** average of $2,041.10 per week is a useful benchmark, but your actual pay will depend on your specific role and agreement.
